jobs.occupation: Research Scientist and Project Coordinator (m/f/d) in the field of Zooplankton Biodiversity (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN) , headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at its institute Senckenberg am Meer, German Centre for Marine Biodiversity Research in Hamburg , starting as soon as possibleResearch Scientist and Project Coordinator (m/f/d) in the field of Zooplankton Biodiversity(full time / part-time )Location: HamburgEmployment scope: full-time / part-time options availableType of contract: temporary contract limited until 30.09.2029Remuneration: collective agreement of the state Hesse, TV-H E13﻿The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.As part of the institute “Senckenberg am Meer” located in Wilhelmshaven, with its two departments Marine Research and German Centre for Marine Biodiversity Research (DZMB), the Hamburg research site, which belongs to the DZMB, focuses on researching taxonomy and systematics of marine life forms.The position is based within the Zooplankton Working Group and is part of the joint project ZooM-In (Innovative Methods for National Zooplankton Monitoring), contributing to the further development and standardization of modern methods for marine biodiversity monitoring. The project is funded by the Federal Ministry for the Environment, Climate Action, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety (BMUKN) through the National Biodiversity Monitoring Centre’s initiative Sustainable Biodiversity Monitoring.The project will be carried out in close cooperation with the Helmholtz Institute for Functional Marine Biodiversity (HIFMB) as well as federal and state authorities.Your tasks- Project management of the project ZooM-In- Organisation of and participation in monthly expeditions (March-October, 3-4 days per months) to the North Sea- Organisation of project workshops- Assessment of zooplankton biodiversity by imaging technologies- Cross validation of zooplankton biodiversity assessment by traditional microscopy, molecular genetics and imaging methods- Communication of project results to stakeholders- Publication of project results in peer-reviewed journals- Writing of a project reportYour profile- Master degree in marine biology or natural sciences- Expertise in the application of plankton imaging technologies (ZooScan and/or PlanktoScope)- Relevant knowledge on molecular genetic analyses of organisms, ideally metabarcoding of zooplankton- Experience in data analyses, preferably using R- Experience with sea-going expeditions on research vessels and sampling of plankton, resilience to motion sickness- Willingness to participate in interdisciplinary work- Very good communication skills, ability to work in a highly collaborative, interdisciplinary and international environment- Very good command of English (written and spoken)- Sound command of the German language is essential for this positionWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application (letter of motivation with a short description of your previous and current research foci, a CV, certificates of academic achievements, list of publications as well as letter(s) of recommendation, if available) (as a single PDF, max. 10 MB) on our career pagehttps://www.senckenberg.de/de/karriere/ by 8 November 2026 .Please note that applications for this position can only be accepted if they are submitted via our online application portal. This ensures that your application is processed correctly and can be considered as part of the selection procedure. Applications sent by email to the Recruiting Team or directly to individual staff members cannot be considered.For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/.For further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung please visit www.senckenberg.de.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt a.M.Please note that applications for this position can only be accepted if they are submitted via our online application portal. This ensures that your application is processed correctly and can be considered as part of the selection procedure. Applications sent by email to the Recruiting Team or directly to individual staff members cannot be considered.

jobs.occupation: Electronics Engineer (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description: The Max Planck Society is Germany's premier research organization. The 86 Max Planck Institutes conduct research at highest levels, in the service of the general public, in the natural sciences, life sciences, social sciences, and the humanities.The Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter (MPSD) is located at the Science Campus Hamburg-Bahrenfeld and investigates dynamical phenomena within matter down to the elementary timescales of atomic and electronic motions, the femtosecond or attosecond timescale. The focus is on the use of short wavelength ultrafast probes, such as X-rays or electron pulses, which are capable of measuring atomic and electronic structures in matter of all kinds.The MPSD currently consists of five scientific departments focusing on solid state physics and theoretical methods in these fields. The MPSD is a partner in the Center for Free-Electron Laser Science (CFEL), collaborating with the Deutsches Elektronen Synchrotron (DESY), European XFEL (EuXFEL) and the University of Hamburg in the development of science based on the X-ray Free Electron Lasers (XFELs).To strengthen our support for experimental research, the MPSD is seeking a highly motivatedElectronics Engineer (m/f/d)Your positionAs an Electronics Engineer, you will support cutting-edge experimental physics research by developing reliable, high-performance electronic systems in close collaboration with scientists, engineers and technical staff.- Develop, design and implement analogue and digital electronic systems for experimental physics applications.- Translate scientific and technical requirements into robust electronic concepts, circuits and complete devices.- Design, assemble, commission and test printed circuit boards (PCBs) and electronic instruments, from initial concept through prototyping to deployment in the laboratory.- Diagnose, troubleshoot and optimise existing electronic systems and measurement equipment.- Develop firmware for microcontrollers and support the integration of hardware, firmware and software components.- Work closely with researchers and engineers to provide practical, user-oriented technical solutions for a broad range of experimental setups.- Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including circuit diagrams, PCB layouts, assembly instructions and test procedures.- As the role involves hands-on development, assembly, testing and support of laboratory equipment, regular on-site presence is an essential part of the position.Your background and skills- A university degree (Master’s degree or Diplom) in electrical engineering, electronics or a closely related field.- Sound practical experience in the development of analogue and digital electronic systems, including circuit design, PCB layout and the assembly, commissioning and testing of electronic devices.- Proficiency in common ECAD tools for schematic capture and PCB design, ideally including KiCad or Autodesk EAGLE, as well as familiarity with circuit-simulation tools.- Knowledge of firmware development for microcontrollers, ideally using C/C++. Experience in developing user software for the control, operation and monitoring of electronic devices is also desirable.- Experience with FPGA development and VHDL is an advantage. Familiarity with CAD systems for mechanical design is also desirable.- A strong understanding of the requirements and working practices of a diverse scientific and technical environment, combined with intercultural competence and effective communication skills.- Excellent written and spoken German and English skills.- Experience in laboratory electronics, measurement technology, scientific instrumentation or experimental physics is desirable.Our offer- A varied and responsible position in an international and interdisciplinary scientific environment, with the opportunity to contribute directly to innovative experimental research.- Close collaboration with scientists, engineers and technical staff on challenging and diverse technical projects.- A family-friendly working environment with flexible working arrangements, in line with the practical requirements of laboratory-based work.- Opportunities for professional development and further training.- Attractive remuneration and social benefits in accordance with the applicable public-sector collective agreement, depending on qualifications and professional experience.- An initial contract for two years, with the possibility of permanent employment thereafter.- The opportunity to work in a collaborative, inclusive and forward-looking research environment.- A subsidy for the Profiticket as a Germany ticketYour applicationThe Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all background.The Max-Planck Society is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals.To apply please complete the online application form and attach you English CV and motivation letter as well as all relevant certificates latest 15th November, 2026.If you have any questions, please feel free to contact contact Dr. Friedjof Tellkamp by email at friedjof.tellkamp@mpsd.mpg.de (https://mailto:friedjof.tellkamp@mpsd.mpg.de) or Dr. Lars Tiemann at lars.tiemann@mpsd.mpg.de (lars.tiemann@mpsd.mpg.de) .Detailed information about the Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter and the online application portal can be found on our website at: https://www.mpsd.mpg.de/karriere/jobs (https://www.mpsd.mpg.de/karriere/jobs)We look forward to your application.

jobs.occupation: Team Leader for Spacecraft Operations (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description: Your Tasks- Disciplinary responsibility for the members of the team- Be the point of contact for the project managers and proposal managers on resource needs- Be the point of contact for the employees on technical matters and professional development- Scheduling of staff incl. cooperation in the recruitment of personnel- Cooperation with the line managers of the department- Ensure technical information exchange and networking within the team, conduct team meetings to share knowledge between projects- Implement lessons learned across projects for systems engineering processes- Ensure the quantitative and qualitative timely provision of the required personnel with adequate skills for OHB System AG's projects- Plan the work processes and tasks of the team, considering the project constraints, by supporting projects in the bidding process,- Ensure completion of the allocated tasks productively, effectively and efficiently, taking into account the legal regulations and valid company agreements- Evaluate compatibility of Technologies and Innovations with existing processes,Support achievement of department goalsYour Qualifications- Degree in engineering, physics or equivalent- Distinctive leadership experience as well as communication and conflict resolution skills- Professional experience in satellite projects in particular in the fields under responsibility of the team- Self-managed and pro-active working style- Ability to work with and implement processes- Ability to work in and coordinate a team- Working level proficiency in written and spoken English. German and other language skills advantageous

jobs.occupation: Systems Engineering Manager (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description: Your Tasks- Lead a team of Systems Engineers in their respective assignments on a project- Act as main focal point on technical issues to Project Managers, AIT, PA/QA, SCM and Customers- Define the system requirements, coordinated with the project management- Define the systems engineering processes and generate an SEP (Systems Engineering Plan), applicable to organize and coordinate the work between the company entities (SE, ENG, AIT, PA/QA and SCM) and the Project Management- Define the basic concepts (top level system design), suitable to fulfill the system requirements in collaboration with the Systems Engineering and Functional Engineering teams. Augment and implement new technologies, if suitable- Generate cost, schedule and performance projections based on the top-level system design- Organize regular checkpoints during the project, integrate cost- and technical budget contributions to establish the overall budgets on system level- Evaluate the running development and design, including initializing independent analyses according to system requirements. Undertake corrective steps in case of deviations- Review the current design and adjust it so that it meets the overall business or mission objectives of OHB, sponsor or customer and user. If necessary, propose changes for contractor's design activities and deliverables to correct performance shortfalls or to mitigate risks- Perform analyses of satellite functional, performance and interface requirements- Act as Systems Engineering responsible for the technical portions of CCNs (contract change note). Arrange implementation of agreed changes to the corresponding design and deliverables and of the implementation of RFWs (request for waiver) or RFDs (request for deviation)- Take care that Launch, LEOP (Launch and Early Orbit Phase) and IOT (In Orbit Test) are properly prepared and lead the corresponding activities during these phases- Ensure technical information exchange and networking within project team, with functional departments and external entitiesYour Qualifications- Degree in engineering, physics or equivalent- Professional experience in satellite design would be advantageous- Self-management and a pro-active working style- Ability to work in a team- Working level proficiency in written and spoken English and German. Other language skills are advantageous
